# Andon

> Andon is an open-source kit for AI-assisted work, written for Claude Code: memory templates, a Stop hook that asks for a same-session verification entry before an agent's "done" claim goes through, and a Defect Ledger of failures from real work, each written as defect, root cause, countermeasure, result.

Plain Markdown and stdlib-only Python 3, with no dependencies. The claim-check hook ships in warn mode; block mode is opt-in. The hook checks that a recent verification entry from the same session shares words with the claim. That does not prove the work happened, and the "Known limits" section of the README lists the gaps.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/README.md): What andon is, a 30-second hook demo, the four layers, and known limits.
- [Defect Ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/DEFECT_LEDGER.md): Defects from real AI-assisted work, each as Defect / Root cause / Countermeasure / Result, grouped under "The patterns underneath".
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for an agent setting andon up in a project, one layer at a time.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/QUICKSTART.md): The four layers, from a memory file to parallel sessions.
- [Hook install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/HOOK_INSTALL.md): Registering the hooks in Claude Code settings, warn mode first, and how to turn them off.

## Hook source

- [claim_check_hook.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/hooks/claim_check_hook.py): Stop hook. Detects done-claims in the turn-ending message and looks for a fresh same-session log entry whose content tokens overlap the claim. Its docstring lists known limits and settings you can tune.
- [log_claim.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/hooks/log_claim.py): Writes the verification entry the claim-check hook reads.
- [auto_orient.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon/main/hooks/auto_orient.py): UserPromptSubmit hook that loads the memory index at session start.

## For agents

To use the Defect Ledger as a self-check before you report a task as done:

1. Fetch DEFECT_LEDGER.md. Each `###` heading is one entry with four labeled lines: **Defect**, **Root cause**, **Countermeasure**, **Result**. Two more lines follow: **Verdict** (is the defect proven?) and **Control** (how far the countermeasure is trusted, and when it is next reviewed).
2. Read "The patterns underneath" before the entries. It names four failure families, with one heuristic each.
3. Treat each Countermeasure line as a check, and apply the ones that fit your task. For example: grep the full set before you claim "all"; run tests against the entry point the harness calls; search for an existing implementation before you build one.
4. If a check fails, fix the gap or narrow your claim to what you verified.
5. If the claim-check hook is installed, record the verification after you run it: `python3 ~/.claude/hooks/log_claim.py "<claim>" "<how you verified it>"`.

The ledger covers failure modes someone has hit before, so clearing it does not prove your work is correct.
